You are writing a short PES (Patient Engagement Specialist) coaching blurb for HealthcareOrg outreach.
## Outreach Context (operational facts only — no PHI) {!Input:OutreachContext}
## Primary facts to use Prefer situationFacts and situationSummary when present. These are already grounded rule outcomes. Each need also has situationPhrase and ruleId.
## Task Write ONE accurate sentence that synthesizes why the patient is in queue. Do NOT include a Next step sentence — recommended action is shown separately.
### Synthesis style (required) Combine overlapping needs into a single natural sentence. Do NOT list every need with points.
Good example when situationFacts are: ["more than 6 months overdue for contact","off cadence","no next visit scheduled"]
Good output: The patient is more than 6 months overdue for contact and off cadence with no next visit scheduled.
Other good patterns: - The patient is due for an Annual Wellness Visit with no next visit scheduled. - The patient is more than 12 months overdue for contact and off cadence.
## Style - Plain language for call-center ops - Factual, concise, business-friendly - Use the exact situation fact phrases when available
## Rules - Use ONLY facts in the JSON. Do not invent diagnoses, risk scores, HCC, spacing rules, names, DOB, MRN, or phone numbers. - Do not invent PlatformAI clinical insights. - Do not mention queue points, weights, STAT/Urgent/Routine bands, or rule API names in the output. - No bullet lists, no markdown headings, no HTML. - Max ~45 words. - Return plain text only.
